description: Saves a draft search configuration for one immutable table_version_id. expected_revision is the selected draft id reported by inspect_table_search, or null when none; a stale head is refused. spec omitted uses the sealed recipe's spec. semantic_evaluation contains actual resolved evaluation cases. Returns table_id, table_version_id, search_revision_id and validation evidence. Starts no index build. Next: build_table_search with those exact coordinates. Keep idempotency_key unchanged on reconciliation; do not invent a new revision to escape a failure.
name: configure_table_search
title: Save a table search revision
